subject: Disconnected from the server but locally working without problems or errors

messages.author: 80e784280245a6e2
messages.subject: Disconnected from the server but locally working without problems or errors
parts:
Hi guys,

I've just deployed my first app, which works perfectly locally. Some parts work ok, but the biggest one, which involves a leaflet map, a dygraph graph and 3 selection boxes, seems to be stucked and it is not working. When i try to interact with one of this elements, the app disconnects from the server. I've already tried to make some tuning and scaling changes, but nothing. And the log does not show any error.

Any help would be very appreciated.

App url: https://futurewater.shinyapps.io/infoSequiApp/

Thank you!

messages.author: 9fd01d2ace71e722
messages.subject: Re: Disconnected from the server but locally working without problems or errors
parts: How large is your data sample? If it's a large data file and it only loads when you access that portion of the app, you may be exceeding your memory limit when the app tries to load the data.

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Disconnected from the server but locally working without problems or errors
parts: It sounds like you may have an install.packages() call in your application.  You should ONLY have library() calls in your application.  the deploy process will detect the dependencies and automatically install them. If that isn't the case please let us know.
